name: Angenehm Platz -Kleiner Garten Sie Erstellen-
original_name: アンゲネームプラッツ-Kleiner Garten Sie Erstellen-
source:
Protagonist Rio’s childhood friend Yuuna likes cosplay, though she tries to keep it as hidden as possible. One day she makes him cosplay as a girl, forcing a girl’s school uniform and a wig onto him. She even makes him wear some make-up. After that she forces him to go home like that without being found out, under the guise that she wants to proof that it’s the perfect crossdressing cosplay.

However, Rio’s true identify is discovered right away by his classmate Nene, a selfish rich girl. Nene then uses this opportunity to turn the 2 of them into her “servants”, telling them that if they won’t do it she would reveal Rio’s “secret” about crossdressing. Leaving Rio and Yuuna no other choice but to accept.

Nene wants to start a cafe club in school and forces them to become club members. She also tells them to find more members. And so it marks the birth of a strange club with an even stranger backstory…

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/angenehm-platz-kleiner-garten-sie-erstellen/]OtakuLair[/url]]
translation:
主角Rio的儿时好友Yuuna喜欢角色扮演，尽管她试图尽可能隐藏它。有一天，她让他扮演女孩，强迫他穿上女孩的校服和假发。她甚至还让他化妆。之后，她就这样在不被发现的情况下强迫他回家，借口是她想证明这是一次完美的变装cosplay。

然而，里奥的真实身份很快就被他的同学内内发现了，内内是一个自私的富家女。内内随后利用这个机会将他们两个变成了她的“仆人”，并告诉他们如果他们不这样做，她就会揭露里约热内卢关于异装的“秘密”。里奥和尤娜别无选择，只能接受。

内内想在学校创办一个咖啡馆俱乐部，并强迫他们成为俱乐部成员。她还告诉他们寻找更多成员。因此，这标志着一个有着更奇怪背景故事的奇怪俱乐部的诞生……
